scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Valid authorized webhook
scenarios.given: An approved channel and sender map to one known provider; valid schema and active replay window.
scenarios.when: Receive one live-format message in an isolated paper fixture.
scenarios.then: Persist envelope before acknowledgment; create one interpretation job; retain original event ID and mode; no broker call at intake.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Invalid transport signature
scenarios.given: Payload contains a plausible trade but its signature fails.
scenarios.then: Reject before parsing/dispatch; zero financial intent/reservation/broker calls; retain sanitized security evidence.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Authorized transport unauthorized sender
scenarios.given: A valid transport signature is present but sender/channel is not allowed.
scenarios.then: Reject source authorization; do not inherit permissions from transport credential.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Unknown provider
scenarios.given: Channel is connected but has no registered provider identity.
scenarios.then: Persist UNKNOWN_PROVIDER and onboarding draft; zero entry effect in live; no assumed analyst edge.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Known provider unknown analyst
scenarios.given: Provider is approved; source author is not mapped.
scenarios.then: Quarantine analyst-dependent action; preserve provider/origin identity and do not copy another analyst's profile.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Disabled provider enabled child
scenarios.given: Provider entry flag is false and analyst preference is true.
scenarios.when: Receive entry then valid exit for existing owned lifecycle.
scenarios.then: Block entry; keep matching scoped exit/protection active; child cannot override parent disable.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Forged forwarded origin
scenarios.given: Authorized relay forwards content claiming a different analyst with no verified lineage.
scenarios.then: Record transport and claimed origin separately; no inferred trading permission from display-name text.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Oversized malformed body
scenarios.given: Body exceeds limits or is not expected object/type.
scenarios.then: Bounded sanitized rejection; no 500 from type assumptions; no queue/resource exhaustion or financial effects.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Persistence unavailable
scenarios.given: The durable envelope insert cannot commit.
scenarios.when: Receive an otherwise valid source message.
scenarios.then: Do not acknowledge durable acceptance or dispatch; emit operational fault and permit documented upstream recovery.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Source replay after crash
scenarios.given: Envelope already committed; process crashed before intake acknowledgment.
scenarios.then: Join existing job/result; exactly one canonical observation and no duplicate trade.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Cross-post same origin
scenarios.given: Two channels deliver same original provider event with established lineage.
scenarios.then: Collapse to one canonical opportunity while retaining both observations; one selected account maximum.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Similar but distinct signals
scenarios.given: Two real lifecycle IDs share ticker, side and text.
scenarios.then: Retain both distinct opportunities; apply concurrent aggregate caps rather than ticker-only deduplication.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Historical backfill
scenarios.given: Import job reads last month's approved channel history.
scenarios.when: A message looks fresh after normalization or UI mode edit.
scenarios.then: Preserve historical mode; no live dispatch; source event time/provenance cannot be rewritten to authorize trading.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Cursor gap reconnect
scenarios.given: Transport disconnects while several source revisions occur.
scenarios.then: Recover permitted gap with durable pagination and revision lineage; do not label history complete until established; stale entries stay non-live.

scenarios.category: Intake, authority, identity and durability
scenarios.title: Prompt injection
scenarios.given: Message instructs agent to ignore limits, run code or expose secrets.
scenarios.then: Treat text as data; no executable instructions, config changes, leaked secrets or trading authority.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Negated buy
scenarios.given: Source text says DO NOT BUY AAPL 10.
scenarios.then: NONACTIONABLE/negated result; zero entry, no substring-based BUY.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Historical recap
scenarios.given: Source says Yesterday we bought AAPL and closed it.
scenarios.then: Historical commentary, not a fresh entry or exit.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Unmet conditional
scenarios.given: Source says Buy only above 100 with a confirmed crossing.
scenarios.then: Durable bounded WAIT_TRIGGER; no immediate order; exact trigger semantics recorded.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Option-flow observation
scenarios.given: Source reports unusual call volume without recommending a trade.
scenarios.then: OBSERVATION only; no BUY_TO_OPEN inference.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Buy put direction
scenarios.given: Exact long-put contract and opening intent are given.
scenarios.then: BUY_TO_OPEN option with bearish underlying exposure; not stock short or sell order.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Ambiguous sell option
scenarios.given: Source says sell puts without stating owned closure versus opening sale.
scenarios.then: PARSE_AMBIGUOUS; no short-option exposure or guessed close.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Independent mixed-assets
scenarios.given: Message contains valid stock and spot-crypto instructions with separate fields.
scenarios.then: Two child instructions with exact asset identities and independent outcomes; each has at most one eligible destination and shared owner caps.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Valid and invalid independent child
scenarios.given: Two independent entries exist; one lacks exact option expiry.
scenarios.then: Block unresolved child; valid child may proceed subject to all caps; parent report lists both outcomes.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Ambiguous shared stop
scenarios.given: Message lists several instruments and one unlabeled stop.
scenarios.then: Block affected instructions; never apply the stop arbitrarily to every instrument.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Atomic vertical spread
scenarios.given: Complete two-leg same-expiry vertical is supplied.
scenarios.when: Normalize and execute in paper fixture.
scenarios.then: One combo group and payoff/risk plan; one qualified combo intent, not two unrelated orders.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Unsupported atomic combo
scenarios.given: Complete spread is given but adapter only supports separate legs.
scenarios.then: Unsupported recipe; no speculative leg-in or naked interim exposure.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Either-or triggers
scenarios.given: Two alternative entries in one exclusive group trigger simultaneously.
scenarios.then: One exclusive opportunity token wins; other terminates/holds per policy; never open both.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Roll dependent actions
scenarios.given: Old option remains open and new roll leg is specified.
scenarios.then: Validate linked group and temporary capital; unconfirmed old close does not authorize an unsafe new naked position.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Reversal
scenarios.given: Account owns a long; signal explicitly requests reverse to short under released policy.
scenarios.then: Close/reconcile old side first, then independently authorize new side; unknown close blocks reversal entry.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Multileg missing ratio
scenarios.given: Butterfly text omits one leg ratio.
scenarios.then: Reject incomplete group; no assumed 1:2:1 from a strategy label alone.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Provider quantity versus copier size
scenarios.given: Analyst reports bought 500 shares.
scenarios.then: Retain analyst quantity separately; user's quantity derives from released risk/capital policy and explicit source ceilings only.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Half-size ambiguous basis
scenarios.given: Source says add half or sell half without a registered denominator.
scenarios.then: Review/incident as appropriate; no invented 50% of current or original inventory.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Price-unit conflict
scenarios.given: Structured stop is option premium and text describes underlying stop.
scenarios.then: Domain conflict blocks plan; no mixing dollar values across instruments.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Attachment-only alert
scenarios.given: Image/audio contains trade details with no qualified parsing path.
scenarios.then: Unsupported-media/observation state; no hallucinated contract or quantity.

scenarios.category: Full-message interpretation and compound instructions
scenarios.title: Locale/time ambiguity
scenarios.given: Date 03/04 and decimal comma are not disambiguated by provider grammar.
scenarios.then: Reject ambiguous date/number; do not choose locale from server defaults.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Edit before dispatch
scenarios.given: Entry is interpreted but no effect can have occurred.
scenarios.then: Version interpretation, invalidate old plan/reservation as safe, revalidate once; not two entries.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Edit after acceptance
scenarios.given: Entry has possible or confirmed broker acceptance.
scenarios.then: Same-lifecycle amendment with revalidation; no new independent order or hidden limit increase.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Delete source message
scenarios.given: Entry is open and source message is deleted.
scenarios.then: Record deletion; retain management; no invented exit unless protocol explicitly defines it.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Exit before entry
scenarios.given: Exit references lifecycle L before its OPEN arrives.
scenarios.then: L remains terminal; no new buy; reconcile any pending effect.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Old exit new same ticker
scenarios.given: L1 is closed and L2 owns same symbol.
scenarios.then: No sale of L2; record already-terminal/orphan match with exact lifecycle evidence.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Duplicate partial exit
scenarios.given: Sell half instruction with fixed event denominator already filled.
scenarios.then: No second halving or order; return existing result.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Delayed exit beyond entry age
scenarios.given: Owned position remains open; valid exit is older than entry freshness limit.
scenarios.then: Resolve current owned remainder and exit policy; do not reject solely using entry TTL.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Exit without fill
scenarios.given: Entry was definitively rejected with zero fills.
scenarios.then: Zero sell; terminal/audit update only, unless pending entry uncertainty still requires reconciliation.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Ambiguous all-out
scenarios.given: Two same-provider lifecycles exist without source reference.
scenarios.when: Receive all out lacking protocol scope.
scenarios.then: Urgent semantic incident; keep protection; no guessed ticker-wide close.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Scoped close-all
scenarios.given: Provider protocol explicitly means its strategy book only.
scenarios.then: Close only matching owned allocations under coordinated writer; manual and other-provider holdings unchanged.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Reply-parent missing
scenarios.given: Exit/update relies on unavailable parent context.
scenarios.then: No invented instrument/lifecycle; collect missing authorized context or hold with incident and existing protection.

scenarios.category: Revisions, lifecycle matching and temporal order
scenarios.title: Future timestamp
scenarios.given: Source time is beyond permitted clock-skew tolerance.
scenarios.then: Flag clock/source anomaly; no accidental negative-age bypass.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Exact stock resolution
scenarios.given: Stock ticker matches a unique tradable instrument for venue/account.
scenarios.then: Persist exact broker ID, currency, lot and tick; no default CRYPTO class.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Ambiguous symbol
scenarios.given: Same display code matches multiple exchanges/products.
scenarios.then: INSTRUMENT_UNRESOLVED; no first-match execution.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Option missing expiry
scenarios.given: Option text has underlying, strike and call but no expiry.
scenarios.then: Reject; no nearest-Friday/nearest-liquid substitution.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Adjusted option deliverable
scenarios.given: Contract has nonstandard multiplier/deliverable.
scenarios.then: Use authoritative actual units/deliverable; all cash/risk calculations reflect adjustment.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Expired option
scenarios.given: Exact contract expiry has passed its tradable deadline.
scenarios.then: Reject stale/expired instrument; no automatic roll.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Continuous futures ticker
scenarios.given: Source names a continuous root without dated contract semantics.
scenarios.then: Observation/unresolved until exact authorized contract chosen; no guessed front month.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Futures negative price
scenarios.given: Instrument profile explicitly supports signed prices and exact tick value.
scenarios.then: Product-correct signed price accepted only within valid profile; quantities remain nonnegative with separate side; stock profile would reject.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: FX lot conversion
scenarios.given: Source quantity is 0.1 standard lot with declared 100000-unit lot.
scenarios.then: 10000 base units, quote/account currency conversion and swap; not 0.1 shares.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Stale FX conversion
scenarios.given: Non-USD risk needs account-currency conversion that is stale.
scenarios.then: Block mandatory conversion-dependent exposure; not assume parity or last-known unlimited freshness.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Crypto fee in base
scenarios.given: Buy 0.01 units and fee removes base inventory.
scenarios.then: Owned quantity is net delivered base units; no stop for more than actual inventory.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Crypto minimum/dust
scenarios.given: Permitted risk yields quantity below lot/minimum notional.
scenarios.then: Skip new entry; existing untradeable dust remains explicit, not falsely closed or rounded up.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Inverse derivative
scenarios.given: Inverse contract has coin collateral and reciprocal payout formula.
scenarios.then: Dedicated inverse model; reject linear-share fallback.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Leveraged inverse ETF
scenarios.given: Source signal references an inverse leveraged fund.
scenarios.then: Use actual economic direction/leverage and scenarios, not a positive one-to-one ticker exposure.

scenarios.category: Instrument metadata, units and product identity
scenarios.title: Metadata change during planning
scenarios.given: Tick/multiplier or instrument trading status version changes.
scenarios.then: Invalidate stale plan and recompute or reject before effect.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Three eligible accounts
scenarios.given: Same source matches three approved account alternatives.
scenarios.then: Select one physical account; exactly one entry intent; persist reasons for the other two not selected.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Duplicate bindings
scenarios.given: Direct and relay connections expose same immutable physical account.
scenarios.then: Count equity once; one candidate identity and approved binding; no duplicate trade.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: No eligible account
scenarios.given: Product or policy unsupported by every approved destination.
scenarios.then: UNROUTABLE/shadow; no auto-activation of a new account or asset substitution.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Better funded alternate
scenarios.given: Preferred candidate cannot meet minimum lot; another approved account can.
scenarios.then: Exclude infeasible account, choose eligible alternative only if released preference permits; one selection.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Wrong gateway default
scenarios.given: Multi-account gateway default differs from selected account.
scenarios.then: Exact selected broker account ID appears on every leg/operation and readback; default cannot route it elsewhere.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Paper/live same alias
scenarios.given: Paper and live accounts share display name.
scenarios.then: Resolve immutable environment-specific identity; zero live credential or endpoint access.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Account liquidation-only
scenarios.given: Account reports close-only restriction.
scenarios.then: Block entry; allow supported scoped risk reduction; explain restriction.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Capability unknown
scenarios.given: Method exists but exact session/stop recipe has no evidence.
scenarios.then: UNVERIFIED blocks new exposure; no method-presence capability inference.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Account changes mid-plan
scenarios.given: Binding/account config version changes after sizing.
scenarios.then: CAS/version check invalidates plan; no use of stale account identity.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Exit after route change
scenarios.given: Lifecycle entered on A; current preference now favors B.
scenarios.then: Exit A's owned allocation; zero order to B.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Timeout then alternate available
scenarios.given: A's order may be accepted; B is healthy and funded.
scenarios.then: Keep A intent UNKNOWN and reservation; no B fallback or duplicate economic position.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Account removal with exposure
scenarios.given: Account has open allocation, pending order or UNKNOWN effect.
scenarios.then: Block destructive action; offer pause/drain; preserve credentials needed for management where permitted.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: Credential rotation same account
scenarios.given: New binding credentials verify same immutable account.
scenarios.then: Preserve lifecycle account identity and single writer; reconcile before resumed dispatch.

scenarios.category: Account identity, selection, permissions and binding
scenarios.title: No alternate live authority
scenarios.given: Initial approved live route unavailable; another broker login exists.
scenarios.then: Do not activate it merely because connected; scoped blocker, independent paper work may continue.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Shared final dollars
scenarios.given: Two entry workers each need $10 risk, only $15 remains.
scenarios.then: Total commitments never exceed $15; one or smaller feasible quantities win by policy; losing transaction recomputes.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Owner cap across accounts
scenarios.given: Each account locally has capacity but owner aggregate would breach.
scenarios.then: Global owner reservation blocks/reduces aggregate; account workers cannot bypass owner cap.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Portfolio backing double count
scenarios.given: Two portfolios claim same $6000 account equity in full.
scenarios.then: Reject overallocated backing; display one real $6000 resource, not $12000.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Sleeve hard reservation
scenarios.given: Sleeve A capacity is hard reserved and unused.
scenarios.then: Deny borrowing absent released sharing policy; no automatic theft of reserved capital.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Soft reservation expiry
scenarios.given: Forecast signal reserve is soft, bounded and expired with no order effect.
scenarios.then: Release unused capacity with evidence; do not reserve indefinitely.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Unknown order reservation TTL
scenarios.given: Order may have been accepted; reservation wall-clock TTL expires.
scenarios.then: Do not release committed resources; reconcile until authoritative outcome.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Reflected broker commitment
scenarios.given: Broker buying power already deducts order X's reserved amount.
scenarios.then: Deduct X only once using explicit reflected membership; avoid false double subtraction.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Unreflected local intent
scenarios.given: Local intent reserved but broker snapshot precedes it.
scenarios.then: Subtract local unreflected commitment; no overspend from stale broker BP.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Partial fill accounting
scenarios.given: 100-share intent reserved, 40 filled and 60 working.
scenarios.then: Transfer 40 into owned exposure, keep 60 pending commitments, no resource creation/release for whole order.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Cancel request
scenarios.given: Working unfilled order reserves risk/cash.
scenarios.then: Retain resources until final cancellation and late-fill reconciliation.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Final reject no fill
scenarios.given: Authoritative rejected state plus complete no-fill evidence.
scenarios.then: Release proven-unused commitments once; no duplicate release on retry.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Withdrawal cash flow
scenarios.given: Owner withdraws funded capital intraday.
scenarios.then: Reduce backing/availability, preserve trading P&L and halt latches, block excess new exposure.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Deposit loss halt
scenarios.given: Daily halt is latched, deposit raises equity.
scenarios.then: No automatic unhalt or erased trading loss; adjust external flow only.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Manual collateral
scenarios.given: Manual positions encumber account margin.
scenarios.then: Reserve their actual whole-account effects; no free collateral assumption or unauthorized sale.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Same-underlying multiple assets
scenarios.given: Shares, calls and correlated futures reference same underlying.
scenarios.then: Enforce consolidated underlying and stress limits across asset labels.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Credit proceeds liability
scenarios.given: Short-credit combo receives premium.
scenarios.then: Liability/collateral remain; credit does not become unlimited free risk budget.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Minimum lot cannot fit
scenarios.given: Budget permits 0.7 whole-share equivalent.
scenarios.then: Zero-unit skip; never floor to one or raise limit to create activity.

scenarios.category: Hierarchical budgets, shared backing and reservations
scenarios.title: Multiple binding constraints
scenarios.given: Risk and cash yield same limiting size.
scenarios.then: Report both tied binding caps and exact quantity, not arbitrary one-only explanation.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Reference stock sizing
scenarios.given: Synthetic equity=6000, risk cap=15, entry=50, stop=49, per-share costs=.05; other caps slack.
scenarios.then: 14 shares, notional 700, planned risk 14.70; exact Decimal result.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Budget below first share
scenarios.given: Same fixture risk budget=.50.
scenarios.then: Zero shares and RISK_LIMITED, no minimum-one override.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Invalid numeric quantity
scenarios.given: Quantity is bool, NaN, Infinity, negative or unsupported zero.
scenarios.then: Reject before reservation/broker effect; product-aware strict type handling.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Wrong-side long stop
scenarios.given: Long entry=50 and initial stop=51 without compatible trigger semantics.
scenarios.then: Invalid/crossed protection rejection; no risk calculated as negative profit.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Missing versus invalid stop
scenarios.given: Source omits stop in case A; supplies malformed stop in B.
scenarios.then: Only A may use compatible released fallback; B rejected/incident, not silently repaired as missing.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Stop tick rounding
scenarios.given: Required long floor falls between supported ticks.
scenarios.then: Select only permitted rounding preserving floor/risk; if unplaceable reject/reduce, never loosen covertly.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Tight stop huge position
scenarios.given: Stop distance near zero and very large Kelly bound.
scenarios.then: Notional, costs, liquidity, stress and margin still cap size; no unbounded exposure.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Option full debit
scenarios.given: Risk budget=15, option premium=2, multiplier=100, before fees.
scenarios.then: Zero contracts because one risks at least 200 debit; no stock-like calculation or stop-only bypass.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Nonlinear margin tier
scenarios.given: Size crossing broker concentration tier raises margin per unit.
scenarios.then: Recompute full post-trade resource function at each candidate boundary; independent-ratio bound alone insufficient.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Fee currency
scenarios.given: Costs charged in different currency than risk equity.
scenarios.then: Convert with valid rate and conservative rounding; no omission or unit addition.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Negative cost input
scenarios.given: Config or feed provides a negative fee/slippage allowance without explicit rebate semantics.
scenarios.then: Reject malformed economics; qualified rebates separately bounded, not negative loss budget.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Zero-risk misleading break-even
scenarios.given: Stop equals entry.
scenarios.then: Costs, mark giveback and stress remain; no infinite quantity or zero whole-account risk.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Cap decreases
scenarios.given: Identical state, lower one hard monetary cap by one cent.
scenarios.then: Permitted quantity cannot increase; independent reference/property test catches nonmonotonic behavior.

scenarios.category: Financial validation and exact sizing
scenarios.title: Worse partial fill
scenarios.given: Actual fill creates larger risk than pretrade allowed.
scenarios.then: Record actual price; cancel remainder safely, protect and follow authorized reduction, never enlarge cap after the fact.

scenarios.category: Kelly, profile evidence and adaptive allocation
scenarios.title: Binary Kelly arithmetic
scenarios.given: Synthetic p=.55 and b=1.4 with outcomes +bR/-1R only.
scenarios.then: f=.228571428571... in risk-fraction convention; arithmetic/unit test independent of application.

scenarios.category: Kelly, profile evidence and adaptive allocation
scenarios.title: Fractional Kelly hard cap
scenarios.given: Quarter Kelly from prior fixture exceeds released .0025 lifecycle fraction.
scenarios.then: .0025 ceiling binds; $6000 fixture gives at most $15 risk, no live config change.

scenarios.category: Kelly, profile evidence and adaptive allocation
scenarios.title: Variable outcomes
scenarios.given: Empirical outcomes include -3R, -.5R, 0, +1R and +5R.
scenarios.then: Optimize full cost-adjusted log distribution; average win/loss shortcut not claimed exact.

scenarios.category: Kelly, profile evidence and adaptive allocation
scenarios.title: Insolvent scenario
scenarios.given: Candidate f makes 1+fX nonpositive for stress X.
scenarios.then: Candidate infeasible, not log clipped to attractive finite value.

scenarios.category: Kelly, profile evidence and adaptive allocation

scenarios.given: Qualified account has distinct long/short tickets.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Manual shares reserved
scenarios.given: Account contains80 manual shares and20 bot-owned.
scenarios.then: At most20 bot shares closed; no account-wide close100.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Manual sell consumes inventory
scenarios.given: Owner manually sells shares overlapping bot attribution.
scenarios.then: Freeze conflicting commands, repair using declared ownership procedure, resize obsolete exits; no automatic buyback.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Manual stop cancel
scenarios.given: Owner cancels a bot protective order outside app.
scenarios.then: Apply owner-intervention/protection policy with visible incident; do not silently ignore or endlessly fight user.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Manual unknown new position
scenarios.given: Broker reveals same-symbol quantity with no bot fills.
scenarios.then: Classify unmanaged/unattributed; do not auto-adopt into latest analyst lifecycle.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Tax lot distinction
scenarios.given: Internal allocation attributes shares to analystB.
scenarios.then: Do not claim that virtual allocation selected broker tax lot; actual tax-lot instruction separate.

scenarios.category: Overlapping ownership and manual intervention
scenarios.title: Fractional split difference
scenarios.given: Corporate action creates fractional shares/cash-in-lieu.
scenarios.then: Apply explicit transformation and cash events; no false unexplained trade or deletion of remainder.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Gap through stop
scenarios.given: Price gaps well below sell-stop trigger.
scenarios.then: Record actual worse fill and realized loss; no backtest fill at stop or guaranteed cap claim.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Halted market exit
scenarios.given: Position held when exchange halts and exit deadline occurs.
scenarios.then: Retain available protection, explicit unable-to-exit incident, no fabricated flatten; manage reopen.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Stock split
scenarios.given: 2-for-1 split occurs with working orders.
scenarios.then: Quantities double and economically corresponding basis/floors adjust; verify broker order changes without phantom P&L.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Reverse split dust
scenarios.given: Reverse split leaves fractional economic interest.
scenarios.then: Track whole quantity and cash-in-lieu separately; no rounding to create shares.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Merger symbol successor
scenarios.given: Old symbol changes into cash plus successor securities.
scenarios.then: Exact deliverable/cash allocation mapping; freeze ambiguous orders and no ticker-only substitution.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Early short-option assignment
scenarios.given: Short leg assigned before expected expiry.
scenarios.then: Post option closure and underlying/cash obligation, reprice actual portfolio, protect/reduce authorized exposure.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Long option automatic exercise
scenarios.given: ITM long remains at cutoff without approved funding plan.
scenarios.then: Preempt by timely authorized policy or handle actual exercised underlying; never assume expiration removes all obligations.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Calendar spread broken state
scenarios.given: Near leg assigned while farther hedge remains.
scenarios.then: Dedicated resultant-risk/collateral handling; not intact-vertical max-loss formula.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Futures delivery deadline
scenarios.given: Contract nears first notice/last trade under no-delivery policy.
scenarios.then: Block entry and execute allowed close/roll plan; failure remains critical, not silent delivery exposure.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Borrow recall
scenarios.given: Broker recalls stock borrow.
scenarios.then: Halt new shorts, preserve authorized cover workflow/cost attribution; no indefinite assumption borrow remains.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Derivative funding debit
scenarios.given: Funding/variation margin reduces collateral materially.
scenarios.then: Adjust cash/headroom and halt/reduce under released limits; no omission from P&L/risk.

scenarios.category: Corporate actions, derivatives and market exceptions
scenarios.title: Broker forced liquidation
scenarios.given: Broker liquidates part/all positions.
scenarios.then: Update ownership, cancel/reconcile conflicting bot orders and latch incident; do not reopen to restore old target.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Crash after reserve before send
scenarios.given: Intent/outbox committed, dispatch not begun.
scenarios.then: Recover same intent, verify no possible effect, revalidate TTL before safe dispatch; no duplicate reservation.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Crash after possible send
scenarios.given: Broker may accept before response persistence.
scenarios.then: UNKNOWN reconciliation on original identity/client key; no fresh create or other-account fallback.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Crash after fill before protection
scenarios.given: Fill exists externally but local protection commit absent.
scenarios.then: Reconcile fill, restore ownership, start/continue overdue protection incident and qualified repair.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Crash after exit fill
scenarios.given: Position flat externally but local exit state stale.
scenarios.then: Deduplicate/readback fill, release only final resources, cancel/reconcile remaining entry/protection families.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Dual workers
scenarios.given: Two processes try same physical-account effect stream.
scenarios.then: Only fenced owner writes; stale worker cannot send after lease loss.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: SQLite busy
scenarios.given: Another short transaction holds write lock during global reserve.
scenarios.then: Bounded retry of entire safe transaction or explicit failure, no stale read-then-write overspend.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Disk full
scenarios.given: Ledger cannot persist intent/response.
scenarios.then: No new effect without durable intent; preserve unresolved state/incident and recover real broker facts after service restored.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Partial broker snapshot
scenarios.given: Positions endpoint errors halfway through pagination.
scenarios.then: Snapshot incomplete/UNKNOWN; never delete missing allocations or label account flat.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Feed outage
scenarios.given: All quote reads fail but worker loop still completes.
scenarios.then: Quote readiness false with age/error evidence; HTTP liveness may remain true; no green protected-trading claim.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Email outage
scenarios.given: Core ledger, broker and native protection remain healthy.
scenarios.then: Record notification failure and alternate existing incident evidence; do not disable valid exit logic.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Optional research failure
scenarios.given: Kelly training dependency errors.
scenarios.then: Frozen released baseline and exit manager continue; optional analytics cannot block risk reduction.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Rate-limit pressure
scenarios.given: Entry burst threatens order/lookup quotas.
scenarios.then: Reserve exit/protection/reconciliation capacity, backpressure new entries; no infinite retry storm.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Expired credential
scenarios.given: Broker token expires with managed exposure.
scenarios.then: Qualified refresh to same account or degraded incident/protection; no switch to first accessible account.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Restore older backup
scenarios.given: Broker effects happened after backup snapshot.
scenarios.then: Reconcile all external post-backup effects and fencing before new entry; never replay old outbox blindly.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Failed migration
scenarios.given: New schema migration aborts mid-upgrade.
scenarios.then: Compatible rollback/blocked startup; no mixed-version writer corrupting ownership/reservations.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: UI unavailable
scenarios.given: Browser/server UI crashes while worker and state healthy.
scenarios.then: Financial management continues independently; incident status later visible.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Lost source connection
scenarios.given: No new provider alerts received, open positions remain.
scenarios.then: Block source-dependent new entries; stops/time exits/reconciliation continue.

scenarios.category: Failure, restart, coordination and operational health
scenarios.title: Overdue deadline restart
scenarios.given: App restarts after mandatory exit time.
scenarios.then: Process overdue exit immediately as feasible, not reschedule next day; preserve inability-to-exit incident.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Daily threshold exact
scenarios.given: Net realized/unrealized/cost loss equals released daily halt threshold.
scenarios.then: Latch policy-defined breach at exact inclusive boundary; cancel safe unfilled entries and preserve exits.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Weekly halt restart
scenarios.given: Weekly halt previously latched.
scenarios.then: Halt persists until released reset procedure; no accidental daily reset clears weekly control.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Fees cross threshold
scenarios.given: Price P&L alone under loss cap, fees/interest push it over.
scenarios.then: Include costs and latch halt; no win-rate-only bypass.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Wrong timezone midnight
scenarios.given: UTC date changes while New York trading session day does not.
scenarios.then: Use released session calendar/timezone for boundaries; no artificial loss reset.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Daylight saving
scenarios.given: Clock changes across DST boundary.
scenarios.then: Correct UTC mapping without duplicate/missing scheduled actions.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Profits not free risk
scenarios.given: Open profitable trade has stop above entry but material giveback/gap exposure.
scenarios.then: Separate original-risk, current-giveback and stress; do not mark portfolio risk zero.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Currency P&L
scenarios.given: Position currency gains but account-currency FX moves adversely.
scenarios.then: Qualified account-currency conversion affects risk and performance, with timestamps/costs.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Withdrawal not loss
scenarios.given: Account equity falls solely from external withdrawal.
scenarios.then: Cashflow-adjusted P&L excludes withdrawal while available capital declines.

scenarios.category: Loss controls, P&L and calendar integrity
scenarios.title: Late fee correction
scenarios.given: Broker posts fee after economic position close.
scenarios.then: Amend lifecycle net result and relevant evidence/model dataset by version; not new trade.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Sizing drilldown
scenarios.given: Candidate size constrained by risk, cash and source limit.
scenarios.then: Show all inputs/caps/as-of times and exact selected size; UI shares backend calculation.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Unknown versus zero
scenarios.given: Broker risk value unavailable.
scenarios.then: Display UNKNOWN/stale, not zero remaining risk or fake safe account.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Desired stop UI
scenarios.given: Pending stop replace would tighten floor.
scenarios.then: Show both desired and confirmed levels/quantities, pending family and deadline.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Source XSS
scenarios.given: Signal symbol/body contains HTML/script payload.
scenarios.then: Text-only safe rendering, no script execution; CSP defense not sole sanitizer.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: CSV formula injection
scenarios.given: Source-controlled export value begins with spreadsheet formula prefix.
scenarios.then: Safe text encoding/escaping policy; no unintended formula execution in consumer file.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: API direct bypass
scenarios.given: UI disables risky control but caller submits direct API request.
scenarios.then: Same effective permission/hard-cap/version checks reject action; no UI-only enforcement.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Stale config edit
scenarios.given: Two browser tabs edit budgets with old version.
scenarios.then: Conflict/revalidation, no lost update or unnoticed raised limit.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Simulation toggle live
scenarios.given: User/client mutates historical/paper mode field.
scenarios.then: Server authorization/environment isolation prevents live route escalation.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Policy publish versus activate
scenarios.given: New Kelly/runner candidate is saved.
scenarios.then: Remains candidate/shadow until scoped release; save is not live activation.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Source disable journey
scenarios.given: User disables provider while positions remain.
scenarios.then: New entries disabled, existing management retained, reason and scope visible.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Account drain journey
scenarios.given: User chooses drain versus disconnect.
scenarios.then: Drain accepts no new exposure but retains readback/protection/exits until final safe detach.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Mobile desktop parity
scenarios.given: Same authenticated role uses phone and desktop.
scenarios.then: No missing confirmations/scope/details due to viewport; backend results identical.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Evidence truthful status
scenarios.given: Only helper/simulator tests passed, no broker paper/live test.
scenarios.then: Exact tested tier and NOT_RUN external scope; no claim actual account certified.

scenarios.category: API, browser, evidence and policy configuration
scenarios.title: Candidate route trace
scenarios.given: Three accounts considered and one selected.
scenarios.then: Exact included/excluded identities and reasons; alternate candidates not shown as executed orders.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Unbound contract harness
scenarios.given: No callable application adapter configured.
scenarios.then: Nonzero error with NOT_BOUND, no fake passes or skipped-green result.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Missing actual result
scenarios.given: Bound adapter omits quantity/selection decision required by case.
scenarios.then: Test fails, not default expected value from catalog.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Dedup guard mutation
scenarios.given: Remove durable source claim in disposable code.
scenarios.then: At least one mandatory test fails; mutant killed.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Reservation guard mutation
scenarios.given: Remove owner-wide atomic reservation.
scenarios.then: Oversubscription detected by independent ledger/invariant; mutant killed.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Close scope mutation
scenarios.given: Replace owned close with ticker-wide close.
scenarios.then: Detect wrong quantities/ownership and fail, even if final account flat.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Protection truth mutation
scenarios.given: Mark desired stop as confirmed immediately.
scenarios.then: Fail risk-release/UI assertions; cannot pass from local config alone.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Boundary mutation
scenarios.given: Change inclusive loss threshold or floor rounding.
scenarios.then: Boundary mismatch fails reliably.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Partial history claim
scenarios.given: Source/backtest dataset has known gaps.
scenarios.then: Missing coverage explicit; no exhaustive-history or proven-return claim.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Paper-to-live auto-promotion
scenarios.given: All paper tests pass.
scenarios.then: No new live authorization, funds transfer, order, cancellation or activated account.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Unsupported extension
scenarios.given: Core equity suite passes while crypto derivative adapter absent.
scenarios.then: Equity evidence scoped; extension remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED/BLOCKED, not overall complete.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: All named scenarios required
scenarios.given: Several applicable named cases lack executable mappings.
scenarios.then: Nonzero incomplete gate; untested cases remain NOT_RUN, never waived by headline test count.

scenarios.category: Verification integrity, mutations and release boundaries
scenarios.title: Competing fault sequence
scenarios.given: Freeze input domains then enumerate every defined critical event ordering.
scenarios.then: Count complete declared vectors, check invariants after every event, retain rejected/unreachable proof and actual evidence.
